verifiedLines.text: Welcome everyone! Today I want to show you something crazy.
We are building an autonomous AI agent workflow from scratch.
Umm... so basically... wait, let me start that part over.
Most developers spend hours editing videos by hand.
[Long 8-second awkward silence while looking at notes]
Instead of manual editing, what if your AI agent directs it like an editor?
Step one is trimming the silence and filler words.
Uhh, like, you know, all the unnecessary pauses.
Step two is cropping your video into a vertical nine by sixteen frame.
Your face stays centered automatically on screen.
Then comes the magic: burning in animated captions.
Highlighted words pop up as you speak them.
Add a crisp title card at the start with smooth audio fades.
No sentence gets cut off in the middle.
Everything fits under sixty seconds for Instagram and Shorts.
Drop a comment below if you want the full template!
